```{r}
trimester2 <- trimester2 %>%

trimester3 <- trimester3 %>%
```

```{r}
second_trimester_filtered <- trimester2 %>%
  select(accession, geo_accession, group, ga_delivery, target, log2rfu) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c('accession', 'geo_accession', 'group', 'ga_delivery'),
              values_from = log2rfu,
              names_from = target)

third_trimester_filtered <- trimester3 %>%
  select(accession, geo_accession, group, ga_delivery, target, log2rfu) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c('accession', 'geo_accession', 'group', 'ga_delivery'),
              values_from = log2rfu,
              names_from = target)
```

```{r}
# Prep the data
second_trimester_metadata <- second_trimester_filtered[, c("accession", "geo_accession", "group", "ga_delivery")]
second_trimester_metadata <- second_trimester_metadata %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "accession")
second_trimester_data <- second_trimester_filtered[, !(names(second_trimester_filtered) %in% c("geo_accession", "group", "ga_delivery"))]
second_trimester_data <- second_trimester_data %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "accession")
```

```{r}
# Step 1: Normalize the data
second_trimester_normalised <- sweep(second_trimester_data, 2, apply(second_trimester_data, 2, median, na.rm = TRUE), "/")

# Step 2: SoftImpute the missing values
soft_imputer <- softImpute(as.matrix(second_trimester_normalised), maxit = 100, trace = TRUE)
second_trim_imputed_array <- complete(as.matrix(second_trimester_normalised), soft_imputer)

# Step 3: Reconstruct data frame
second_trimester_imputed_norm <- as.data.frame(second_trim_imputed_array)
rownames(second_trimester_imputed_norm) <- rownames(second_trimester_normalised)
colnames(second_trimester_imputed_norm) <- colnames(second_trimester_normalised)
second_trimester_imputed_norm

# Step 4: Batch correct
batch <- second_trimester_metadata$geo_accession
group <- second_trimester_metadata$group
#mod <- model.matrix(~ group, data = second_trimester_metadata)
mod_simple <- model.matrix(~ 1, data = second_trimester_metadata)

combat_corrected <- ComBat(dat = t(as.matrix(second_trimester_imputed_norm)),
                           batch = batch,
                           mod = mod_simple, # Use the simple model
                           par.prior = TRUE,
                           prior.plots = FALSE)
combat_corrected <- t(combat_corrected)

# 4.2. limma's removeBatchEffect
limma_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(t(as.matrix(second_trimester_imputed_norm)),
                                     batch = batch,
                                     design = mod_simple)

# 4.3. PCA-based approach with missMDA (if you want to try integrated imputation/correction)

# Perform imputation with estimated dimensions

# Now perform PCA on imputed data
#res.pca <- PCA(imputed_data$completeObs, graph = FALSE)
# Extract coordinates for the first few principal components
#mda_corrected <- res.pca$ind$coord

# Visualization function for PCA results
# Improved visualization function with better error handling
plot_pca <- function(pca_data, title, metadata) {
  # Create a data frame with PCA coordinates
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_data)
  
  # Check if PCA data has row names
  if(is.null(rownames(pca_df))) {
    warning("PCA data doesn't have row names. Using sequential indexing.")
    rownames(pca_df) <- 1:nrow(pca_df)
  }
  
  # Check if metadata has row names
  if(is.null(rownames(metadata))) {
    warning("Metadata doesn't have row names. Using sequential indexing.")
    rownames(metadata) <- 1:nrow(metadata)
  }
  
  # Find common row names between PCA results and metadata
  common_rows <- intersect(rownames(pca_df), rownames(metadata))
  
  if(length(common_rows) == 0) {
    stop("No common row names between PCA results and metadata.")
  }
  
  # Subset both data frames to common rows
  pca_df <- pca_df[common_rows, ]
  metadata_sub <- metadata[common_rows, ]
  
  # Add metadata to the PCA data frame
  pca_df$group <- metadata_sub$group
  pca_df$geo_accession <- metadata_sub$geo_accession
  
  # Check for NA values in aesthetics
  if(any(is.na(pca_df$group)) || any(is.na(pca_df$geo_accession))) {
    warning("NA values found in aesthetic mappings. These points will not be plotted.")
  }
  
  ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group, shape = geo_accession)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Perform PCA on each corrected dataset
pca_combat <- prcomp(t(combat_corrected), scale. = TRUE)
pca_limma <- prcomp(t(limma_corrected), scale. = TRUE)

# Plot results
plot_pca(pca_combat$x[, 1:2], "PCA after ComBat Correction", second_trimester_metadata)
plot_pca(pca_limma$x[, 1:2], "PCA after limma Correction", second_trimester_metadata)
#plot_pca(mda_corrected[, 1:2], "PCA with missMDA Approach", second_trimester_metadata)
```

```{r}
cat("NA values in geo_accession:", sum(is.na(second_trimester_metadata$geo_accession)), "\n")
```
